packageRules.description: Group non-major Action updates. The main ruleset requires an approving review, so this arms GitHub's auto-merge rather than merging unattended: the PR lands by itself once someone approves it and the checks pass. Renovate keeps the digest pinned and rewrites the # vX comment.
Action major bumps (e.g. checkout v4 -> v5) get their own reviewable PR, never auto-merged.
pre-commit hook bumps are always reviewed -- a clang-format or squawk version can reformat/flag the whole tree.
